mode_selection_rules.diagnosis_only: Use when the project is new, unclear, or the user wants an initial scan only.
mode_selection_rules.strategy_run: Use when the user wants architecture and strategy but not costing or build.
mode_selection_rules.build_ready_run: Use when the user wants a plan that is safe and costed, but no implementation yet.
mode_selection_rules.full_run: Use when the user explicitly asks to run the full OS.
mode_selection_rules.maintenance_run: Use after the system exists and needs review, improvement, or update.
mode_selection_rules.research_run: Use for market, technical, workflow, or domain research before architecture.
mode_selection_rules.qa_run: Use when testing, safety review, or validation is the main task.
